title: 🔴 MSFS | City Update 15 LIVE Review & Piper M600 Turboprop Test Flight! ✈️
description:
🔴 We are LIVE reviewing the brand new Microsoft Flight Simulator City Update 15 (Midwest US) and taking the highly anticipated Expert Series 02: Piper M600 by FSReborn out for a full test flight! 

City Update 15 drops us right into the American Heartland, featuring high-fidelity photogrammetry (TIN) for Chicago (and the legendary Meigs Field!), Minneapolis-St. Paul (timed with FlightSimExpo 2026), and Milwaukee. 

To explore these massive regional upgrades, we are firing up the brand-new Expert Series Piper M600 turboprop. With its 600-hp Pratt & Whitney PT6A engine and advanced Garmin G3000 avionics suite, we'll see if this $24.99 Marketplace release truly lives up to its "Expert Series" badge.

Stream Timeline (19:30 CET / Europe Time):
0:00 - Stream Start & Welcome
05:00 - Piper M600 Flight Deck Setup & Overview (Garmin G3000)
15:00 - Cold & Dark Departure 
30:00 - Exploring Chicago Photogrammetry & Meigs Field
45:00 - Milwaukee Sights & Performance Testing
1:00:00 - FSExpo 2026 Special: Arriving in Minneapolis-St. Paul
1:20:00 - HALO Safety System & Autoland Test
1:35:00 - Final Verdict: Is City Update 15 + Piper M600 Worth It?
1:45:00 - Community Q&A and Chat Flight
